quote: My son used to think school and Islamic studies lived in two separate worlds. At ICCRA, they finally overlap — he comes home talking about his science project and his tajweed lesson in the same breath, and honestly, so do we.
The teachers actually know my daughter. Not just her name — her handwriting, her favorite surah, the subject she struggles with. That's rare.
I like that it's live, not just videos. I can ask my teacher a question and she actually answers me right there.
Every field trip somehow connects back to what they're learning. It never feels like a random day off — it feels like the lesson stepped outside.
Moving from a full-time Islamic school to ICCRA's blended model made me nervous. A month in, my kids were more engaged than they'd ever been — and still finishing their Qur'an goals every week.
